prompt: Add a custom Umbraco 17 Health Check that checks whether robots.txt exists and offers a safe action to create it when missing. Use localized messages and explain how the check can be scheduled and notified.
expectations: The implementation derives from the current Umbraco HealthCheck API and returns an explicit success or error status
A remediation action is offered only when the file is missing, has a stable alias, and is validated in ExecuteAction
Write failures are surfaced as an error and logged rather than swallowed or reported as success
User-facing messages use the project localization mechanism, and the response links to official Health Check and health-check configuration documentation
The response explains that scheduled execution/notifications are separate from dashboard loading
